scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Proof over algebraically closed fields of characteristic three only, for the displayed smooth marked family; no claimed complete Ekedahl-Oort type, injectivity of moduli parametrization, or independent historical-priority certification. Finite-field verification corroborates rather than proves the infinite statement.
title: A supersingular divisor and a two-polygon theorem for genus-three order-four hyperelliptic curves in characteristic three
